User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the SpeakSelf AI application.

avatar.description: URL of the user's avatar image.

preferredAiPersonality.description: The user's preferred AI personality mode.

themePreference.description: The user's preferred UI theme (light, dark, auto).

voiceSpeed.description: The user's preferred voice speed for TTS.

voicePitch.description: The user's preferred voice pitch for TTS.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the user account was created.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: Represents a single conversation session between a user and the AI.

startTime.description: Timestamp of when the session started.

endTime.description: Timestamp of when the session ended.

aiPersonality.description: The AI personality mode used during the session.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message within a session.

sender.description: Indicates who sent the message (user or ai).

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the message was sent.

Analytics.title: Analytics
Analytics.description: Stores analytical data for a user's sessions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the analytics data.

wordsPerMinute.description: Words spoken per minute during the session.

lexicalRichness.description: A measure of lexical richness (unique word count / total word count).

pauseLength.description: Average length of pauses during the session.

responseLatency.description: Average time taken for the AI to respond.

autobiographicalDepthScore.description: A score indicating the depth of autobiographical content.

narrativeContinuityScore.description: A score indicating the narrative continuity of the session.

aiVsUserTalkRatio.description: The ratio of AI speech to user speech.

Summary.title: Summary
Summary.description: Stores the AI-generated summary of a session.

id.description: Unique identifier for the session summary.

userFocus.description: What the user primarily talked about during the session.

aiFocus.description: What the AI primarily focused on during the session.

identityThemes.description: Key identity themes that emerged during the session.

emotionalCues.description: Significant emotional cues observed during the session.

strengths.description: Identified strengths of the user in the conversation.

weaknesses.description: Identified weaknesses of the user in the conversation.

confidenceRating.description: A confidence rating for the session.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to support the SpeakSelf AI application, prioritizing authorization independence, clarity, and scalability. It leverages path-based ownership for user-specific data and avoids `get()` calls in security rules by denormalizing authorization information where needed. 

*   `/users/{userId}`: Stores user profiles and preferences. This collection utilizes path-based ownership, ensuring only the authenticated user can access their own profile.
*   `/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}`: Stores session metadata. This subcollection inherits ownership from the parent `/users/{userId}` document, ensuring that only the user can access their own sessions. No denormalization is required as authorization is based on path.
*   `/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}/messages/{messageId}`: Stores messages within a session.  Ownership is inherited from the parent `/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}`, again ensuring only the user can access their own messages.  Authorization is based on path.
*   `/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}/summary`: Stores AI-generated summaries of sessions. Ownership is inherited from the parent `/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}`, ensuring the user is authorized.  Authorization is based on path.
*   `/users/{userId}/analytics/{analyticsId}`: Stores analytics data for a user's sessions.  Ownership is inherited from the parent `/users/{userId}`, ensuring the user is authorized.  Authorization is based on path.

This structure promotes Authorization Independence because access control is determined by the document path (path-based ownership) which relies on request.auth.uid. This eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules, enabling atomic operations and simplifying debugging. Homogeneous Security Posture is maintained by ensuring each collection only contains documents with the same access requirements.  QAPs are supported because `list` operations are naturally secured by the path-based ownership model; a user can only list the documents within their own path.
